display_name.description: User-friendly name for the CalDAV account type shown in the account setup list.

server_url_template.description: CalDAV server URL template; '{{ username }}' is replaced with the user's account username at login. Should include protocol and trailing slash.

use_ssl.description: Whether to enforce SSL/TLS encryption for all server connections.

enable_discovery.description: Whether to attempt WebDAV auto-discovery (e.g., via /.well-known/caldav) before using the explicit ServerURL.

collection_path.description: Optional URL path prefix for calendar collections. Leave empty to use server defaults or discovery results.

auth_method.description: Authentication method to use: 'Basic' (username/password), 'OAuth2', or custom 'Token' (bearer token).

allow_plaintext_credentials.description: Whether to allow storing passwords in plaintext if secure credential storage fails. Unsafe — disable unless necessary for legacy environments.

request_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for HTTP requests before timing out.

auto_sync.description: Whether to automatically sync calendar events on network change or timer (requires background sync support).

sync_interval.description: Interval in seconds between background syncs. Set to 0 to disable automatic sync (manual-only).

collections.description: List of supported calendar collection profiles to present in the UI. Each defines a named, optional MIME type.

mime_type.description: MIME type the server advertises for this collection (e.g., 'text/calendar', 'application/calendar+json').

custom_headers.description: Optional list of custom HTTP headers to send with every CalDAV request (e.g., for proxy authentication or tenant IDs).
